name: How does ADU permit coordination differ from general construction permits?

mainEntity.name: How does ADU permit coordination differ from general construction permits?

acceptedAnswer.text: ADU permit coordination is a specialized type of permitting that specifically addresses the unique requirements for Accessory Dwelling Units, which often benefit from streamlined state-mandated regulations. While general construction permits cover a wide range of building projects, ADU coordination focuses on maximizing ADU-specific exemptions and incentives, such as reduced setbacks or parking requirements, where applicable. Our coordination efforts ensure your project leverages these specific ADU advantages.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU permit coordination specializes in ADU-specific regulations and exemptions, differing from general construction permits which cover broader projects.
